_comment: Proposed emu/games.json entries for Dream (the manager registers them). Paths relative to the repo root.

dream.title: Dream (tiny diffusion model, 4 MB)
dream.controls: Type a subject (e.g. house) and press Return, or click Dream; Return with an empty box or Surprise me picks one of 220. The picture develops from static in 6 steps (about 95 s on a real Plus); click to stop after the current step. File menu: Copy Picture, Save as MacPaint. Loads its model for about 55 s first.

dream_1mb.title: Dream (1 MB Plus, 32x32)
dream_1mb.controls: Same as Dream, at 32x32 with 191 subjects (about 48 s per picture on a real Plus).

dream_se.title: Dream (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
dream_se.status: ready (same app and model; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)
dream_se.controls: As Dream (about 85 s per picture on a real SE).
